name: deskworlds
description: Living worlds for your macOS desktop: Riverbed, a planted river, Coral reef, a coral reef, Betta, a single betta, Plasma globe, a plasma globe in a dark room, Koi pond, koi in a dark garden pond seen from above, Bonfire, a coiled sword in a bonfire at night, Lake storm, a cabin window on a mountain lake in a storm, and Cherry blossom, an old cherry on a lake islet under a slowly turning sky of stars.

scripts.check: node --check serve.mjs && for f in scenes/*/src/*.js scenes/shared/*.js ui/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: node ui/tests/gallery.mjs && node ui/tests/worlds.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/fish-behavior.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/render-policy.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/plant-budget.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/environment.mjs && node scenes/reefscape/tests/behavior.mjs && node scenes/reefscape/tests/assets.mjs && node scenes/reefscape/tests/locomotion.mjs && node scenes/reefscape/tests/anemone.mjs && node scenes/bettascape/tests/food.mjs && node scenes/plasmascape/tests/plasma.mjs && node scenes/koiscape/tests/behavior.mjs && node scenes/bonfirescape/tests/fire.mjs && node scenes/lakescape/tests/storm.mjs && node scenes/lakescape/tests/glass.mjs && node scenes/blossomscape/tests/tree.mjs && node scenes/blossomscape/tests/world.mjs
